title: Go-Global Digitization Monthly No.01 | Meta Q3 Ads Rely on China, Alibaba.com Opens AI Business Assistant, TikTok Told to Fix Malaysia Compliance

html:
Unique Research · Insight / go-global monthly · November 2, 2023 · Unique Research go-global desk

October go-global martech financings

1. Inteluck — $34M Series C. SEA tech-driven logistics; lead Navegar (Philippines PE); East Ventures follow; Favour Capital exclusive FA. Founded 2014 by Forbes 30U30 Zhang Zihao; Singapore HQ; Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam — FTL, warehouse, international freight, distribution, custom supply-chain SaaS.

2. GreenSen Industrial (绿森工业品) — multi-million RMB angel. Unique Capital FA. Nanjing (2020); industrial cross-border procurement + engineering services for factories in MENA, Africa, LatAm, Central Asia; ~1,000+ suppliers; own site + smart SaaS (design/sales/logistics/tech); platform plans after scale.

3. WorkMagic — multi-million USD angel. Sinovation Ventures lead; 42Chapter exclusive FA + follow. GenAI multi-agent marketing SaaS for Shopify SMBs — CRM, merchandise, marketing. WorkMagic Copilot 1.0: AI copy/images (scene, model), blog/email; social automation + multi-channel attribution; team from TikTok, Facebook, Amazon, Waymo.

4. J&T Express (极兔) IPO on HKEX (27 Oct). Ticker 1519; offer HK$12; net proceeds HK$3.528B. Hour-one quote HK$12.02; market cap >HK$100B — highest HKEX IPO market cap of the year. Founded 2015 Indonesia electronics delivery → e-comm express; expanding MENA, LatAm, North Africa.

October industry dynamics

1. Meta Q3 — revenue highly dependent on Chinese advertisers. Post-close 25 Oct: Q3 revenue $34.15B (+23% YoY) vs. $33.51B expected; net income $11.58B (+164%) vs. $9.39B expected. Family DAU 3.14B (+7%). CFO Susan Li: North America ads ~+7% on strong Chinese advertiser demand; EU +21% (Chinese demand + FX); APAC ~+9% (SEA advertisers + FX); Rest of World +~20 pts, Brazil led partly by Chinese advertiser demand there.

2. Xmars — first APAC and only global winner of 2023 Amazon Technology Innovation Award (23 Oct, Amazon Ads Partner Awards at unBoxed, NYC). SparkXGlobal’s cross-border AI ad-optimization SaaS.

3. Alibaba.com AI Business Assistant opens to all foreign-trade merchants from 1 Nov. Deep trade-industry AI product; beta: ~+19% exposure. Smart listing, smart reception; one-click title/desc/image/explainer video tuned to overseas demand — embedded in trade workflow on live Alibaba.com data.

4. Alibaba.com Southeast Asia country pavilions (31 Oct). One-click product move + translation; multi-store collect; smart analyze/optimize — extra push on SEA.

5. TikTok Shop U.S. opens self-operated (POP) invite for cross-border merchants (China entity or China-legal U.S. entity). Full self-managed listing/sales/marketing/logistics; three invite types: U.S. local ship, brand go-global, jewelry/crystal — different thresholds. Social+e-comm pivot vs. traditional e-comm.

6. Cainiao International × COSCO Shipping South China — SEA 8-day e-comm ocean express (19 Oct) with “late = compensate.” Shekou/Nansha → Port Klang / Singapore; ~5 days faster than peers; dense weekly sailings for Double 11 / Christmas.

October policy trends

1. TikTok, YouTube, Meta seeking Indonesia e-comm licenses (Reuters). TikTok talks with local platforms incl. GoTo’s Tokopedia; separate TikTok Shop app considered. Meta applied for promote-goods (not in-app checkout) license for FB/IG/WA. YouTube also weighing a license type. Trade ministry: TikTok would need an Indonesian subsidiary for an e-comm license.

2. TikTok told to remediate in Malaysia. Communications & Digital Minister Fahmi Fadzil: compliance with Malaysian law still unsatisfactory after meeting TikTok Global VP Helena Lersch; follow-up with MCMC and TikTok. Unlike Indonesia’s e-comm ban on TikTok, Malaysia weighing factors (predatory pricing, data sharing, data sovereignty) before further decisions; TikTok Shop info under KKD review.

3. Shopify Markets Pro opens to B2B sellers (eligibility) — cross-border payments, shipping, duties; auto-detect business customers; still does not natively support B2B order types (seller acts as registered merchant).

Unique Partner note

Partner Kuaizi Tech (筷子科技) marked 3 years of its full-chain AIGC content commerce collaboration/growth platform — ~4,000 enterprise customers; >30M creative videos generated; >1.2B seconds of production video supplied.

Go-global reports shared

  • 2023 North America Go-Global Guide (U.S. & Canada) — LinkedIn
  • 2023 Q3 Go-Global Brand Social Influence Rankings — OneSight BrandOS (FB/IG/X/YouTube)
  • 2023 Domestic Brand Go-Global Development Report — Google “nine capabilities” (brand, marketing, product, data focus)

13 CN images; attach on ingest.

— END —
